variety_description: A high-yielding, late maturity, medium height, short bold grain variety, grown extensively in north India. Developed by PAU and released in 1998. Highly adapted to irrigated lowlands. This variety is beneficial to the farmers on account of its higher yield, suitable growth duration, and better disease resistance.
